trial_court: Court of learned Senior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, HMOP No.28 of 2018
case_name: G. Veera Prasad vs G. Srilatha
facts_of_case: The parties are married and have been living separately. The respondent filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights (HMOP No.28 of 2018) and the petitioner filed a petition for dissolution of marriage (FCOP No.629 of 2016). Both matters are pending.

legal_principles.principle: The possibility of avoiding conflicting findings is seen when the same Court considers both matters.
legal_principles.held: By this process, in as much as the same Court considers both these matters, possibility of avoiding conflicting findings is very much seen.
cited_cases: Kaligithi Priyanka v. Javudula Rajeev Gandhi, (2020) 3 ALD 87

legal_principles.principle: The course to follow to transfer a case from the Court of learned Family Judge to the Court of learned Senior Civil Judge is not barred.
legal_principles.held: Thus, there is no legal bar for the Court of Senior Civil Judge to consider a matter, which was earlier pending in the Family Court and which is brought to on its file by mechanism of transfer, in terms of Sec
cited_cases: Kaligithi Priyanka v. Javudula Rajeev Gandhi, (2020) 3 ALD 87
keywords: Court of learned Senior Civil Judge

outcome.final_order: The matter will be transferred to the Family Court, Guntur.

use_for_drafting: assisting with transfer of cases between courts
